## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

```css
font: var(--text-body);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Font files

Fonts: one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`) and upload it as an asset where you use it (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) — HTML/CSS: an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule; a Slides deck: write `fonts/<id>` = `{"family":"<family>","src":"<the url the upload returned>"}`. `tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that inlines it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `fonts/<id>` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geist | `fonts/geist-400-normal.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-display)` | `geist` |
| Geist Mono | `fonts/geist-mono-400-normal.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-mono)` | `geist-mono` |
| Inter | `fonts/inter-latin-400-normal.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-body)` | `inter` |

Every face: `fonts/geist-300-normal.woff2` (Geist, 300), `fonts/geist-400-normal.woff2` (Geist, 400), `fonts/geist-500-normal.woff2` (Geist, 500), `fonts/geist-600-normal.woff2` (Geist, 600), `fonts/geist-mono-400-normal.woff2` (Geist Mono, 400), `fonts/geist-mono-500-normal.woff2` (Geist Mono, 500), `fonts/inter-latin-400-normal.woff2` (Inter, 400), `fonts/inter-latin-ext-400-normal.woff2` (Inter, 400), `fonts/inter-latin-500-normal.woff2` (Inter, 500), `fonts/inter-latin-ext-500-normal.woff2` (Inter, 500), `fonts/inter-latin-600-normal.woff2` (Inter, 600), `fonts/inter-latin-ext-600-normal.woff2` (Inter, 600).
